definitions.explanation: An intensifier used to emphasize the truth or degree of something; often expresses genuine feeling or evaluation.

examples.japanese: {実|じつ}に{素晴|すば}らしい{景色|けしき}だ。
{実|じつ}に{残念|ざんねん}なことだ。
これは{実|じつ}に{興味深|きょうみぶか}い{研究|けんきゅう}だ。

notes:
USAGE: {実|じつ}に is a formal intensifier expressing genuine emphasis. It's commonly used in written language and speeches.

REGISTER: Formal/literary. In casual speech, 本当に or すごく are more common.

CONTRAST:
・{実|じつ}に - indeed, truly (formal, emphatic)
・{本当|ほんとう}に - really (general use)
・まことに/{誠|まこと}に - truly (very formal, humble)
・すごく - very (casual)
